notes.title: First update of 2023: new crew, new ship!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The start of 2023 has been a bit quiet, but mainly because we've been working towards something very exciting which we're finally able to talk about. Not only have we hired a new full-time artist, but he's finished the first of many new ship designs. Say hello to the Sukula-class space barge:

[previewyoutube=pDWpnJef67I;full][/previewyoutube]

What you see here is a mining barge - it will be the primary ship used for mining resources in the game. We plan to have another variant that will serve a separate logistical function, but we'll save that for a later reveal!

Our new artist's name is Aleksandre 'Alex' Lortkipanidze, and you can see some of his past work here - we're very excited to have him on the team. 

The Sukula is just the beginning! We'll be designing other brand new ships, but also re-designing existing ship models as we move away from purchased assets to bespoke ones designed from the ground up. Next up will be a rework of the Hano, and we'll let you know when it's new form is ready to be revealed!

That's not the only thing we've been working on though. If you watch the trailer closely you'll also be able to see the result of improvements to UI, a new tactical waypoint system, obstacle avoidance, and collision mechanics.

This is going to be an exciting year for Falling Frontier, and we want to thank everyone for their support and patience up until now. We can't wait to share more in the coming months.

notes.title: Falling Frontier New Trailer and Release Q2 2022 Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We've made the decision to delay the Early Access release target for Falling Frontier to Q2 of 2022. As part of the delay announcement an almost 7 minute trailer has been created that contains 100% new content, all from the Falling Frontier storyline campaign ‘Titan Rising’. A new station, ships, and mechanics are shown off as well as some of the improvements to the ship designer. 

We appreciate all the support and encouragement we’ve received throughout the development process so far and we look forward to sharing more details with you in the future.
